how_to_read_this: Only 3 forecast(s) have been scored. At this sample size the calibration curve and the per-cohort scores are indicative at best — a single question resolving the other way would move them visibly. Every table here carries its n for that reason.
25 question(s) are still open and will be scored as their markets settle.
Brier score: lower is better. 0.25 is what you get by always saying 50%, so it is the bar any forecaster must clear to be worth running.
Forecasts marked failed, timed_out, or needs_clarification are excluded from every score but are counted in forecasts_by_status — a metric that silently drops its failures overstates itself.
